decision: Earth Engine via Python API with a job registry (gee/jobs.py) and task manifest
alternatives: Code Editor JS scripts; geemap notebooks
reason: Reproducible re-extraction (level 2) and resumable batch submission

decision: Talukas from geoBoundaries ADM3 (125 features) as the provisional admin spine
reason: geoBoundaries ADM2 lacks Larkana and uses pre-2017 districts; replace with OCHA COD-AB on Day 12

decision: Climate grids (CHIRPS/ERA5-Land) exported as rasters before the inventory exists
reason: Coarse cells are shared by many villages; cell-id join locally; zonal variant kept

decision: Wave 1 submitted with local GeoJSON admin layers embedded in tasks instead of uploaded assets
alternatives: Wait for asset access; upload-admin first
reason: Asset root not writable on day of submission; admin() falls back to data/village_inventory/admin/*_simplified.geojson, so outputs are identical; provisional settlements go to Drive GeoJSON only

decision: OCHA COD-AB 2022 (pcodes PK7xxyy) becomes the admin spine for the province-wide inventory; geoBoundaries ADM3 kept only for outputs already produced with it
reason: geoBoundaries ADM3 has no Jacobabad taluka polygon (3% covered) and lacks Islamkot/Kaloi/Dahli; OCHA covers all 125 tehsils, matches 109/114 PBS talukas by name (5 unmatched are Karachi sub-divisions); missing Open Buildings for Jacobabad and Bin Qasim exported by job open_buildings_gaps
